description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller, HomeController, which handles root URL requests and redirects them to the Swagger UI interface. It is part of a larger bank application, specifically within the controller package, and manages URL routing for the application's main page to facilitate API documentation access.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller that redirects root URL requests to the Swagger UI documentation page.

methods.name: redirectToSwaggerUi
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the root URLs '/' and '', redirecting users to the Swagger UI interface at '/swagger-ui/index.html'.
